item.title: Measuring Browser and DOM Dimensions
item.description:
Browser APIs expose several coordinate systems because a screen, browser window, viewport, document, and element answer different measurement questions. Choosing an API by name alone can therefore produce scrollbar, rounding, or scrolling errors.

Window, Screen, and Viewport Measurements #

API Measurement
window.innerWidth, innerHeight Layout viewport, including a rendered classic scrollbar
window.outerWidth, outerHeight Browser window’s outside dimensions
screen.width, screen.height Screen dimensions in CSS pixels
screen.availWidth, screen.availHeight Screen space excluding reserved operating-system areas
document.documentElement.clientWidth, clientHeight Layout viewport excluding a classic scrollbar

CSS pixels are logical units. A CSS pixel can cover multiple device pixels on a high-density display, so screen.width does not necessarily equal the panel’s physical pixel count.
